plan.authorization: User requested a more source-aligned supplementary implementation; parent chose EC-QPF module framing before execution.
plan.question: For a controlled one-step Gaussian state-estimation update, how do source EC-QPF selection operators compare with classical selection using the identical noisy center, ellipse, and fitness?
plan.scope: One-step resampling/selection operator only; not source tracking experiment or full PF reproduction; no quantum hardware.
plan.estimand: Mean across 30 independently generated seed datasets of within-dataset 2D state RMSE for returned ensemble mean; paired source operator minus each same-constraint baseline.
plan.statistical_unit: independently generated seed dataset with 20 independent one-step updates
plan.analysis_unit: seed-dataset RMSE; do not treat 600 updates as 600 independent method comparisons

generator.truth: independent draw from prior each update
generator.candidate_particles: 500 independent prior draws; identical candidate particles for all methods; truth never passed to algorithms

audit_completion_choices.ellipse_center: observed noisy state z; supplied shared operator input, not source IMU center construction
audit_completion_choices.fitness_variance: mean of the two coordinate population variances within shared ellipse
audit_completion_choices.q_meaning: probability of bit zero, following literal Eq.(12), despite selection-probability prose conflict
audit_completion_choices.empty_subset: invalid fitness -infinity; if every candidate subset empty, fail run rather than silently fill
audit_completion_choices.duplication: balanced cyclic repetition of selected indices to N=500; affects estimate when cardinality does not divide N
audit_completion_choices.no_candidates_in_ellipse: fail run, retain artifact, no replacement or exclusion
audit_completion_choices.stopping: max20 generations or no global-best fitness improvement for10 consecutive generations, following prose half-Iter_Max rule

plan.contextual_baseline: full_systematic_likelihood uses entire candidate cloud; does not share ellipse/fitness; not evidence of a quantum mechanism effect

baseline_contract.ellipse_exact_fitness: Identical ellipse and source Eq.22: nonempty-subset mean distance minimized by nearest singleton; exact classical maximum, no tuned parameters.
baseline_contract.ellipse_systematic_fitness: Identical ellipse and singleton source Eq.22 scores exp(-distance/(2V)), normalized, systematic resampling to500.
baseline_contract.full_systematic_likelihood: Gaussian observation likelihood exp(-squared distance/2), systematic resampling to500.

secondary: RMSE versus analytic Gaussian posterior mean 25/26*z
source-fitness score and gap to exact classical optimum
CPU wall-clock seconds including module initialization
endpoints.ess: ESS computed only from explicitly normalized sampling weights of systematic baselines; not defined for source/greedy binary selection and not replaced by subset size

analysis.paired_bootstrap: 20000 resamples at independent seed-dataset level, fixed seed9301; percentile95%CI
analysis.paired_effect_size: mean paired difference / sample SD of differences
analysis.paired_permutation: 50000 sign flips fixed seed9302 plus one correction
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction of two primary paired permutation p-values
analysis.interpretation: no posterior-consistency/quantum-speedup/original-algorithm efficacy claim; source-faithful module comparison only

plan.tuning: zero outcome-driven tuning for all methods; source coefficients frozen; added parameters disclosed, no selection based on outputs
plan.exclusion: none; any nonfinite, empty ellipse/subset, invalid normalized weight terminates that run; failures retained and no default replacement seeds

failure_tree.improvement: CI below0: describe only this controlled module error difference; no algorithm efficacy attribution
failure_tree.worsening: CI above0: describe only this completed operator/controlled-input result; no source algorithm rejection
failure_tree.inconclusive: CI contains0: no observed difference in this setting; no equivalence claim
failure_tree.guardrails: finite inputs/probabilities, valid selected subset, no truth at selection interface, consistent shared ellipse IDs, source fitness <= exact optimum within1e-12

plan.reproducibility: Two independent seed0 run directories; compare raw array/metrics hashes excluding CPU runtime; exact same environment only.
